title: New Release ROADBIKE JAVA VITTORIA 12speed  eR7 Ltwoo

takeaways.text: At 173 cm the presenter is near the limit of the size 50 (54 cm top tube, 120 mm stem); sizes 48 and 50 in black only.
Aluminium frame with carbon fork, bar and seatpost, internal cables, L-TWOO ER7 electronic 2×12 with USB charging, 160/140 mm hydraulic rotors and 30 mm alloy wheels.
Clearance is already tight with the stock 28 mm Kenda tires, and tighter at the rear.
About Rp 16.5 million offline, quoted at 10.6 kg without pedals.

disclosure: An Indonesian shop presenting a bike it sells; the bike shown is the aluminium-frame Vittoria ER7, one of the two frame versions the candidate leaves unresolved.
summary: An Indonesian shop's look at the aluminium-frame JAVA Vittoria with L-TWOO ER7 electronic shifting; Indonesian automatic captions.
